text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear communication. First, manage your time by breaking large tasks into smaller steps and setting your own mini-deadlines. Next, prioritize your work: decide which tasks are most important and do them first. Scope management is also key, so be realistic about what you can finish and avoid taking on too much. Finally, communicate openly with your team or manager. If a problem appears, speak up early instead of waiting until the last minute. By following these simple habits, you can reduce stress, stay organized, and meet your deadlines more successfully.
